exposure: Type of healthcare provider (midwifery care vs. obstetric care)
outcome: Maternal and neonatal admission to intensive care
cohort: 11,537 women with normal, low- and medium-risk pregnancies in Spain from 2016 to 2019
finding: Midwifery care was associated with lower rates of operative births and severe perineal damage without increasing the risk of adverse outcomes compared to obstetric care.
